item.title: Saint Mary's annual Donor Challenge brings in $1.3 million
item.description: This year's annual Donor Challenge at Saint Mary's raised$1.3 million for theSaint Mary's Fund.This money is used to support many different aspects of campus life. item.description: Fifteen teams get into the Atlantic Coast Conference men's basketball tournament. item.description: There is a phrase often invoked to describe Notre Dame's institutional identity: ex corde ecclesiae, from the heart of the church. item.title: Holy Cross College spring formal returns with masquerade theme
item.description: Tickets for Holy Cross College's spring formal are currently on sale ahead of the event, which will take place on March 27 at The Armory.
